title: Asymptotically Z-stable bundles over projective surfaces
summary: We study the existence of asymptotically $Z$-stable (a.Z stable) bundles over polycyclic surfaces. Our choice of polynomial central charge is related to the existence of solutions of the deformed Hermitian--Yang--Mills equations, with vanishing $B$-field, in the large-volume limit. The main result is a technique to construct rank $3$, strictly a.Z-stable bundles as extensions of a line bundle by a $μ$-stable bundle of rank $2$.
